audit_purpose: Verify ReflexBench evaluation prompts are disjoint from Trained MoE GRPO training corpus, supporting the Self-Evaluation Disclosure in Section 5 of the main paper.
method: SHA-256 over each scenario prompt; cross-check against full hash list of training corpus.
result: 0 overlaps detected across 80 evaluation prompts (20 scenarios x 4 parts) and 1332 training prompts.
note: Full hash lists are in audit_full_hashes.txt (this representative sample is for quick visual check). The disjointness check itself is reproducible by running scoring/audit_disjoint.py against scenarios/ + the released training pipeline.
